POST /api/v1/people/{id}/discord-account.errors: Unknown/hidden identity is 404 or denied. Stale version conflicts. Delegated managers cannot create broader authority than they possess; revoked credentials cannot be used.

POST /api/v1/requests/{id}/blocking.description: Only the requesting agent may declare or clear its own open single-agent blocking dependency. Does not cancel the request.
POST /api/v1/requests/{id}/blocking.audience: Current requester, authorized original decision recipient or exact bound executor, according to operation.
POST /api/v1/requests/{id}/blocking.errors: Invalid outcome/choice fails validation. A stale request version or terminal-state race conflicts. Permission is rechecked at decision, redemption and reporting.

POST /api/v1/fleet/coordinate.description: Plan and dispatch distinct ordinary communications under current permissions, then durably collect and summarize settled replies. Idempotent recovery. Does not grant business execution authority. Use /fleet/plan and /fleet/command for explicit review.
POST /api/v1/fleet/coordinate.returns: Automatic OverseerPlan with selected specialists and attributed dispatches, or a status answer.
POST /api/v1/fleet/coordinate.audience: Authenticated person with current fleet visibility and required contact/assistance permissions. This is available in OSS without the UI.
POST /api/v1/fleet/coordinate.errors: Disabled/unconfigured assistance or provider failure returns an assistance error. Stale/expired plans, changed scope or revoked access block dispatch. Per-person model calls are rate-limited.

POST /api/v1/capabilities.description: Current operation eligibility, not an authorization token. Every mutation rechecks current policy. Exact requests include audience, original Ask, reverse response and conditions.
POST /api/v1/capabilities.returns: CapabilityResult: observed_at, operation-name booleans, and optional request_version/outcomes for a requested decision.
POST /api/v1/capabilities.audience: Authenticated caller with view/message/ask authority for the resolved recipients or current conversation history.
POST /api/v1/capabilities.errors: Changed audience/preview, conflicting versions, hidden history or missing reverse contact rights reject the operation. Reuse the same saved key only for the same intended write.

GET /api/v1/access.description: Own effective access, including direct/group role provenance. Inspecting another subject requires identity visibility and explicit view access:<subject ID>, or an administrator credential.
GET /api/v1/access.returns: AccessSnapshot: subject, authority basis, role assignments with provenance and observation time.
GET /api/v1/access.audience: Authenticated caller with view/message/ask authority for the resolved recipients or current conversation history.
GET /api/v1/access.errors: Changed audience/preview, conflicting versions, hidden history or missing reverse contact rights reject the operation. Reuse the same saved key only for the same intended write.

POST /api/v1/query.description: Complete bounded keyset reads with current per-record authorization. Continue until next_cursor is absent, including empty pages. Cursors are encrypted and bound to scope, actor, filters and limit for 24 hours. Message history requires conversation_id and is chronological; other collections use stable ascending IDs. Unsupported filters are rejected.
POST /api/v1/query.returns: QueryPage: collection-specific items, optional next_cursor and stable order. Continue while next_cursor exists, including empty visible pages.
POST /api/v1/query.audience: Authenticated caller with view/message/ask authority for the resolved recipients or current conversation history.
POST /api/v1/query.errors: Changed audience/preview, conflicting versions, hidden history or missing reverse contact rights reject the operation. Reuse the same saved key only for the same intended write.

POST /api/v1/agents/{id}/contacts.description: Non-sending current contact observation for an agent. Requires subject access inspection. Returns only caller-visible contacts that the agent can view and contact. Channel kinds/modes are shown only where the caller can inspect the recipient destination. No addresses, installation IDs, credentials or send authority are returned.
POST /api/v1/agents/{id}/contacts.returns: AgentContacts: contacts with target, name, message/ask capability and route projections, plus observed_at.
POST /api/v1/agents/{id}/contacts.audience: Authenticated identity; mutations require management authority over the relevant resource. Enrollment requires a bounded launcher or operator.
POST /api/v1/agents/{id}/contacts.errors: Unknown/hidden identity is 404 or denied. Stale version conflicts. Delegated managers cannot create broader authority than they possess; revoked credentials cannot be used.

POST /api/v1/dispatch-preview.description: Non-sending preview of 1 to 100 explicit individual/instance targets. Includes native, primary, copy and fallback permission/enablement observations. Token binds the authorized audience and route revisions for ten minutes. Hidden recipient identities and addresses remain private.
POST /api/v1/dispatch-preview.returns: Resolved recipient and route projection, a short-lived token and expiry; `sends` is false.
POST /api/v1/dispatch-preview.audience: Authenticated caller with view/message/ask authority for the resolved recipients or current conversation history.
POST /api/v1/dispatch-preview.errors: Changed audience/preview, conflicting versions, hidden history or missing reverse contact rights reject the operation. Reuse the same saved key only for the same intended write.

POST /api/v1/message-batches.description: Atomic explicit recipient dispatch, deduplicated by logical identity. Conflicting replica targets are rejected. Private conversations and per-target receipts; failure rolls back the entire batch. Optional preview token prevents changed routes/audience from silently proceeding.
POST /api/v1/message-batches.returns: Array of {target, result: SendResult}. Every target retains its own private history and canonical attribution.
POST /api/v1/message-batches.audience: Authenticated caller with view/message/ask authority for the resolved recipients or current conversation history.
POST /api/v1/message-batches.errors: Changed audience/preview, conflicting versions, hidden history or missing reverse contact rights reject the operation. Reuse the same saved key only for the same intended write.

POST /api/v1/request-batches.description: Atomic private request per explicit target. Each request has an independent response and execution lifecycle; no implicit shared approval or first-responder broadcast. The nested request must omit target and conversation_id.
POST /api/v1/request-batches.returns: Array of {target, request: Request}. Requests resolve independently after atomic batch creation.
POST /api/v1/request-batches.audience: Authenticated caller with view/message/ask authority for the resolved recipients or current conversation history.
POST /api/v1/request-batches.errors: Changed audience/preview, conflicting versions, hidden history or missing reverse contact rights reject the operation. Reuse the same saved key only for the same intended write.

GET /api/v1/integrations/catalog.description: Supported providers and actual fields/capabilities only. Native inbox is built in; no planned integration is installable.
GET /api/v1/integrations/catalog.returns: Array of ProviderCapability records with required configuration fields, native reply/approval support and setup modes.
GET /api/v1/integrations/catalog.audience: Authenticated identity with current connection/destination visibility or management authority. Sending a test also requires contact rights.
GET /api/v1/integrations/catalog.errors: Invalid provider fields, missing verified account or disallowed URL fail validation. A stale configuration version conflicts. Provider acceptance alone does not establish a reply.

GET /api/v1/connections/{id}/diagnostics.description: Non-sending credential checks and correlated diagnostic transport evidence. Configuration changes reset test evidence. Provider acceptance is distinct from attributed reply and independent live qualification.
GET /api/v1/connections/{id}/diagnostics.returns: ConnectionDiagnostic with safe configuration, provider acceptance and attributed engine-observed test evidence. This read sends nothing.
GET /api/v1/connections/{id}/diagnostics.audience: Authenticated identity with current connection/destination visibility or management authority. Sending a test also requires contact rights.
GET /api/v1/connections/{id}/diagnostics.errors: Invalid provider fields, missing verified account or disallowed URL fail validation. A stale configuration version conflicts. Provider acceptance alone does not establish a reply.

POST /api/v1/connections/{id}/test.description: Explicit durable test message to one configured destination only. Requires installation/destination management and Message permission. Queue acceptance is not provider acceptance. Inspect delivery evidence afterwards.
POST /api/v1/connections/{id}/test.returns: Queued test Delivery. Read diagnostics and obtain an attributed native reply separately; acceptance is not receipt.
POST /api/v1/connections/{id}/test.audience: Authenticated identity with current connection/destination visibility or management authority. Sending a test also requires contact rights.
POST /api/v1/connections/{id}/test.errors: Invalid provider fields, missing verified account or disallowed URL fail validation. A stale configuration version conflicts. Provider acceptance alone does not establish a reply.

GET /api/v1/requests/{id}/trace.description: Current authorized request, paged delivery evidence and execution reports. Audience members see their own projection; requesters can inspect their outgoing deliveries. Provider acceptance never proves execution.
GET /api/v1/requests/{id}/trace.returns: `request` plus independently paginated `deliveries` and `executions`, with an `evidence` explanation. Continue transport pages using the supplied cursor.
GET /api/v1/requests/{id}/trace.audience: Current requester, authorized original decision recipient or exact bound executor, according to operation.
GET /api/v1/requests/{id}/trace.errors: Invalid outcome/choice fails validation. A stale request version or terminal-state race conflicts. Permission is rechecked at decision, redemption and reporting.

GET /api/v1/workspace.description: Authenticated scope, company, environment, deployment kind and schema version. Managed composition supplies deployment metadata explicitly.
GET /api/v1/workspace.returns: Workspace metadata and current account-read capability.
GET /api/v1/workspace.audience: Authenticated caller with view/message/ask authority for the resolved recipients or current conversation history.
GET /api/v1/workspace.errors: Changed audience/preview, conflicting versions, hidden history or missing reverse contact rights reject the operation. Reuse the same saved key only for the same intended write.

GET /api/v1/workspace/account.description: Person-only scoped account access requires view account:workspace or an administrator credential. This entry point permits status inspection during service suspension with a still-valid credential and current account policy. Runtime-applied quotas/usage are separate from server-side managed requested/provisioning/entitlement state. No operator tokens enter the browser; managed read failures are 503, never zero usage.
GET /api/v1/workspace/account.returns: Current authorized account snapshot, applied limits and UTC-month usage. This OSS projection does not expose a managed payment provider.
GET /api/v1/workspace/account.audience: Authenticated caller with view/message/ask authority for the resolved recipients or current conversation history.
GET /api/v1/workspace/account.errors: Changed audience/preview, conflicting versions, hidden history or missing reverse contact rights reject the operation. Reuse the same saved key only for the same intended write.

POST /api/v1/roles/preview.description: Non-saving, version-checked role-edit preview. Same rule ceiling and assignment boundaries as SaveRole; reports exact affected assignments and before/after role-grant checks for authorized subjects. Administrator credential power and new assignments are not simulated. Other assigned roles remain effective.
POST /api/v1/roles/preview.returns: `can_save`, current `version`, `affected_assignments`, before/after `checks`, `basis` and `saves=false`. This simulates existing assignments without saving or granting new ones.
POST /api/v1/roles/preview.audience: Authenticated identity; mutations require management authority over the relevant resource. Enrollment requires a bounded launcher or operator.
POST /api/v1/roles/preview.errors: Unknown/hidden identity is 404 or denied. Stale version conflicts. Delegated managers cannot create broader authority than they possess; revoked credentials cannot be used.

POST /api/v1/conversations.description: Start an explicit shared chat with a durable first message. Individual recipients only; all members must have current mutual view permission. Every later send checks current contact access. Idempotent; private broadcast contracts are unchanged.
POST /api/v1/conversations.returns: SendResult containing the new shared conversation_id and canonical first messages.
POST /api/v1/conversations.audience: Authenticated caller with view/message/ask authority for the resolved recipients or current conversation history.
POST /api/v1/conversations.errors: Changed audience/preview, conflicting versions, hidden history or missing reverse contact rights reject the operation. Reuse the same saved key only for the same intended write.

POST /api/v1/contact-permissions.description: Atomically save and assign a dedicated contact-access policy. Only view, message, ask and decide toward exact contacts. Existing delegation ceilings and observed-version checks apply. Inherited policies remain effective.
POST /api/v1/contact-permissions.returns: The saved Role containing the chosen directional contact rules. Chat membership is separate.
POST /api/v1/contact-permissions.audience: Authenticated caller with view/message/ask authority for the resolved recipients or current conversation history.
POST /api/v1/contact-permissions.errors: Changed audience/preview, conflicting versions, hidden history or missing reverse contact rights reject the operation. Reuse the same saved key only for the same intended write.

POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/membersh.description: Versioned and idempotent shared-chat membership. Manager or admin can rename/add/remove; members can leave. New members see history from joining unless share_history is explicitly true. Current mutual View is required; membership grants no contact, decision or tool authority. Removing or leaving stops future read and delivery; already downloaded data cannot be recalled. A departing manager names an existing successor.
POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/membersh.returns: conversation_id and new version, with left=true when the caller leaves.
POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/membersh.audience: Authenticated caller with view/message/ask authority for the resolved recipients or current conversation history.
POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/membersh.errors: Changed audience/preview, conflicting versions, hidden history or missing reverse contact rights reject the operation. Reuse the same saved key only for the same intended write.

POST /api/v1/messages.description: Durably store canonical messages and queue deliveries. Prefer: return=minimal returns a compact acceptance receipt; it is not delivery or execution confirmation. Replay the same input and idempotency key without Prefer to retrieve the full result without resending.
POST /api/v1/messages.returns: SendResult containing conversation_id and messages, or SendReceipt containing conversation_id and message_count when Prefer: return=minimal is requested.
POST /api/v1/messages.audience: Authenticated caller with view/message/ask authority for the resolved recipients or current conversation history.
POST /api/v1/messages.errors: Changed audience/preview, conflicting versions, hidden history or missing reverse contact rights reject the operation. Reuse the same saved key only for the same intended write.

POST /api/v1/attachments.description: Stage a private file for up to 24 hours. Only its uploader can read it until a keyed communication atomically claims attachment_ids. Maximum five files per message, 5 MiB each. An abandoned draft expires; upload itself has no automatic retry contract.
POST /api/v1/attachments.returns: Attachment metadata with its private draft ID or authorized conversation association. The response is not the file bytes.
POST /api/v1/attachments.audience: Authenticated uploader or currently authorized conversation participant, subject to history visibility.
POST /api/v1/attachments.errors: Empty/oversized files are rejected. An already claimed or expired staged ID cannot be bound again. Removed members cannot bypass history checks with a known ID.

GET /api/v1/connections/{id}/setup.description: Authorized credential-free setup steps and generated BYO manifest. Never contacts providers or changes registrations.
GET /api/v1/connections/{id}/setup.returns: ProviderSetup: safe callbacks, manifests/registration steps and current diagnostic evidence, without credentials.
GET /api/v1/connections/{id}/setup.audience: Authenticated identity with current connection/destination visibility or management authority. Sending a test also requires contact rights.
GET /api/v1/connections/{id}/setup.errors: Invalid provider fields, missing verified account or disallowed URL fail validation. A stale configuration version conflicts. Provider acceptance alone does not establish a reply.

POST /api/v1/people/{id}/telegram-accoun.returns: `{removed: true}` after the authorized change commits. This acknowledgment does not contain an updated resource or prove business execution.
POST /api/v1/people/{id}/telegram-accoun.audience: Authenticated identity; mutations require management authority over the relevant resource. Enrollment requires a bounded launcher or operator.
POST /api/v1/people/{id}/telegram-accoun.errors: Unknown/hidden identity is 404 or denied. Stale version conflicts. Delegated managers cannot create broader authority than they possess; revoked credentials cannot be used.

POST /integrations/telegram/{id}.description: Secret-authenticated private bot updates. Canonical message/decision, thread and dedup receipt commit before success. Same ID with changed content conflicts. See docs/TELEGRAM.md.
POST /integrations/telegram/{id}.returns: A message receipt has conversation_id and message_count. A decision receipt has conversation_id, request_id and outcome (approved or denied). Ignored unsupported update categories return {ignored: true}. Each handled receipt follows durable commit.
POST /integrations/telegram/{id}.audience: Provider callback. Use its native signature/secret verification, not a worker bearer token.
POST /integrations/telegram/{id}.errors: Invalid signatures or account linkage are rejected. Duplicate delivery is deduplicated; changed content under the same provider event identity conflicts.

POST /api/v1/people/{id}/discord-account.description: Unlink the Person Discord identity. Queued sends and callbacks lose authority.
POST /api/v1/people/{id}/discord-account.returns: `{removed: true}` after the authorized change commits. This acknowledgment does not contain an updated resource or prove business execution.
POST /api/v1/people/{id}/discord-account.audience: Authenticated identity; mutations require management authority over the relevant resource. Enrollment requires a bounded launcher or operator.
POST /api/v1/people/{id}/discord-account.errors: Unknown/hidden identity is 404 or denied. Stale version conflicts. Delegated managers cannot create broader authority than they possess; revoked credentials cannot be used.

POST /integrations/discord/{id}.description: Ed25519-authenticated Discord interactions. Bot DM commands, reply forms and versioned approvals only. Commits canonical actions and dedup receipt before acknowledgment. See docs/DISCORD.md.
POST /integrations/discord/{id}.returns: Discord interaction response: type plus optional data in the native Discord schema. Canonical receipt metadata stays internal; do not expect a Beepgrid message object in this HTTP response.
POST /integrations/discord/{id}.audience: Provider callback. Use its native signature/secret verification, not a worker bearer token.
POST /integrations/discord/{id}.errors: Invalid signatures or account linkage are rejected. Duplicate delivery is deduplicated; changed content under the same provider event identity conflicts.

POST /api/v1/contact-permissions/preview.description: Preview current contact permissions or a proposed versioned edit without saving. Explicit blocks override matching role grants.
POST /api/v1/contact-permissions/preview.audience: The subject, an authorized access inspector or the administrator. Proposed edits require current management and assignment authority.
POST /api/v1/contact-permissions/preview.returns: The current direct policy, effective action cells and sources for up to 100 contacts, warnings and save eligibility.
POST /api/v1/contact-permissions/preview.errors: Reload on version conflict. Visibility and assignment authority remain separate. A preview is never a grant.

POST /api/v1/appearance.description: Change an Agent or group icon from the bundled pack, or reset its default.
POST /api/v1/appearance.returns: Target, selected icon and current group version. Appearance changes do not alter membership or permissions.
POST /api/v1/appearance.audience: A current manager of the target Agent or group.
POST /api/v1/appearance.errors: Invalid icons are rejected. A stale group revision conflicts. Other workspaces and unmanaged identities remain inaccessible.

GET /api/v1/people/{id}/delivery-prefere.audience: Person self, administrator or an explicitly authorized identity manager. Preferences never grant contact or channel authority.
GET /api/v1/people/{id}/delivery-prefere.errors: Forbidden for another Person without management authority; stale versions conflict. Invalid selectors, foreign destinations and invalid timer bounds fail validation.
GET /api/v1/people/{id}/delivery-prefere.description: Read recipient channel defaults and ordered Agent/Agent role overrides.
GET /api/v1/people/{id}/delivery-prefere.returns: DeliveryPreferences with its current version; null default retains legacy destination settings.

POST /api/v1/people/{id}/delivery-prefer.audience: Person self, administrator or an explicitly authorized identity manager. Preferences never grant contact or channel authority.
POST /api/v1/people/{id}/delivery-prefer.errors: Forbidden for another Person without management authority; stale versions conflict. Invalid selectors, foreign destinations and invalid timer bounds fail validation.
POST /api/v1/people/{id}/delivery-prefer.description: Save versioned recipient channel preferences. Individual Agent overrides win, then the first matching Agent role, then default. Preferred channels fail over on definite failure and optionally on an unresolved question/approval timer after provider acceptance. All sends selected channels immediately. Empty destinations means workspace only. Saving cancels pending external sends from the previous configuration; in-flight effects cannot be recalled.
POST /api/v1/people/{id}/delivery-prefer.returns: Saved DeliveryPreferences with the incremented version.

POST /api/v1/credentials/{id}/edit.description: Rename a token, change expiry or update its permission ceiling using the observed version.
POST /api/v1/credentials/{id}/edit.returns: Current metadata with the next version. Never returns the secret.
POST /api/v1/credentials/{id}/edit.audience: Authorized credential manager, or the current worker for self-renewal. Token limits never grant identity permissions.
POST /api/v1/credentials/{id}/edit.errors: Stale versions conflict. Expired or revoked tokens cannot renew or rotate. Restricted tokens cannot mint or broaden credentials.

POST /api/v1/credentials/{id}/rotate.description: Replace a token secret while preserving its identity, instance and permissions. Choose a zero to 86400 second overlap.
POST /api/v1/credentials/{id}/rotate.returns: New token secret once, plus metadata including previous_until. No automatic retry after an uncertain outcome.
POST /api/v1/credentials/{id}/rotate.audience: Authorized credential manager, or the current worker for self-renewal. Token limits never grant identity permissions.
POST /api/v1/credentials/{id}/rotate.errors: Stale versions conflict. Expired or revoked tokens cannot renew or rotate. Restricted tokens cannot mint or broaden credentials.

POST /api/v1/credentials/self/renew.description: Renew the current renewable worker lease, capped by its hard deadline. Active traffic renews near expiry automatically.
POST /api/v1/credentials/self/renew.returns: Current credential metadata. No new instance or secret is created.
POST /api/v1/credentials/self/renew.audience: Authorized credential manager, or the current worker for self-renewal. Token limits never grant identity permissions.
POST /api/v1/credentials/self/renew.errors: Stale versions conflict. Expired or revoked tokens cannot renew or rotate. Restricted tokens cannot mint or broaden credentials.

POST /api/v1/anycast.description: Queue a message or request for one available permitted member of an agent role.
POST /api/v1/anycast.returns: AnycastDispatch with current state and, after selection, agent, runtime, conversation and optional request IDs.
POST /api/v1/anycast.audience: Authenticated sender with message or request token scope and current contact authority; reads and cancellation require the original sender or administrator. Completion requires the exact assigned worker.
POST /api/v1/anycast.errors: Invalid role/input is 400; policy denial is 403; hidden dispatch is 404; conflicting replay or lifecycle is 409; queue limit is 429. Retry with the same idempotency key and identical input. ACK does not release capacity.

GET /api/v1/anycast.description: List up to 100 of your latest Anycast dispatches.
GET /api/v1/anycast.returns: Up to 100 AnycastDispatch records, newest first. Input contains a 240-character body preview and omits choices, action and attachment IDs. Read an individual dispatch for its full input.
GET /api/v1/anycast.audience: Authenticated sender with message or request token scope and current contact authority; reads and cancellation require the original sender or administrator. Completion requires the exact assigned worker.
GET /api/v1/anycast.errors: Invalid role/input is 400; policy denial is 403; hidden dispatch is 404; conflicting replay or lifecycle is 409; queue limit is 429. Retry with the same idempotency key and identical input. ACK does not release capacity.

GET /api/v1/anycast/{id}.description: Read the current state of your Anycast dispatch.
GET /api/v1/anycast/{id}.returns: AnycastDispatch including selected conversation and request IDs when assigned.
GET /api/v1/anycast/{id}.audience: Authenticated sender with message or request token scope and current contact authority; reads and cancellation require the original sender or administrator. Completion requires the exact assigned worker.
GET /api/v1/anycast/{id}.errors: Invalid role/input is 400; policy denial is 403; hidden dispatch is 404; conflicting replay or lifecycle is 409; queue limit is 429. Retry with the same idempotency key and identical input. ACK does not release capacity.

POST /api/v1/anycast/{id}/cancel.description: Cancel a queued Anycast dispatch before assignment.
POST /api/v1/anycast/{id}/cancel.returns: Object with cancelled: true. Assigned work must be followed up in its conversation.
POST /api/v1/anycast/{id}/cancel.audience: Authenticated sender with message or request token scope and current contact authority; reads and cancellation require the original sender or administrator. Completion requires the exact assigned worker.
POST /api/v1/anycast/{id}/cancel.errors: Invalid role/input is 400; policy denial is 403; hidden dispatch is 404; conflicting replay or lifecycle is 409; queue limit is 429. Retry with the same idempotency key and identical input. ACK does not release capacity.

POST /api/v1/worker/anycast/{id}/complet.description: Release an accepted dispatch reservation after the host finishes or stops its handler.
POST /api/v1/worker/anycast/{id}/complet.returns: Object with completed: true. This is not a business execution success claim.
POST /api/v1/worker/anycast/{id}/complet.audience: Authenticated sender with message or request token scope and current contact authority; reads and cancellation require the original sender or administrator. Completion requires the exact assigned worker.
POST /api/v1/worker/anycast/{id}/complet.errors: Invalid role/input is 400; policy denial is 403; hidden dispatch is 404; conflicting replay or lifecycle is 409; queue limit is 429. Retry with the same idempotency key and identical input. ACK does not release capacity.

GET /api/v1/connections/{id}/channels.description: Read configured Slack channels and Agent access. One policy applies to the channel across recipient destinations.
GET /api/v1/connections/{id}/channels.returns: Array of ProviderChannel records with address, display name, restricted flag, allowed Agent and Agent role targets, and version.
GET /api/v1/connections/{id}/channels.errors: Unauthorized callers are denied. Existing channel configuration does not prove provider delivery.

POST /api/v1/connections/{id}/channels.description: Save versioned Slack channel settings and an optional Agent allowlist. This narrows contact permission and does not grant conversation membership.
POST /api/v1/connections/{id}/channels.returns: The saved ProviderChannel with its new version. Restricted channels with an empty allowed list block every Agent. People remain subject to their own contact and decision permissions.
POST /api/v1/connections/{id}/channels.audience: Authorized connection managers only. Targets must be existing Agents or Agent roles in this workspace.
POST /api/v1/connections/{id}/channels.errors: Stale versions conflict. Use version 0 for a new channel. Restrictions apply to future dispatches, queued sends, replies and fallbacks; sends already in flight cannot be recalled.

GET /api/v1/connections/{id}/slack-chann.description: List one page of joined, non-archived Slack channels. Pass next_cursor as the cursor query parameter to continue even after an empty page.
GET /api/v1/connections/{id}/slack-chann.returns: Object containing channels and optional next_cursor. The engine requests one bounded provider page and keeps bot credentials server-side.
GET /api/v1/connections/{id}/slack-chann.audience: Authorized connection managers only, with a configured Slack bot.
GET /api/v1/connections/{id}/slack-chann.errors: Missing Slack scopes require updating the manifest and reinstalling the app. Invite the bot to each desired channel. Rate limits require waiting; this lookup never joins channels or changes the provider.
